scripts.deploy:worker: npm run check:deployment && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/prepare-worker-assets.mjs && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --config=wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run check:deployment && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:pages && npm run build:pages:functions && npm run verify:pages && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy dist-pages/web-user --project-name=hendy-web-user --branch=main --no-bundle && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy dist-pages/web-admin --project-name=hendy-web-admin --branch=main --no-bundle && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy dist-pages/operations --project-name=hendy-operations --branch=main --no-bundle
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:pages:user && npm run build:pages:admin && npm run build:pages:operations
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:pages
